$comment: Approved packs whose composed template web bundles CI pre-builds into the platform deployer's build cache (scripts/bake-web-bundles.sh, ci.yml web-bundles job) so a project's FIRST publish restores a bundle instead of building one. Client-only packs only — a fullstack pack listed here is skipped at bake time (its VITE_GRAPHQL_URL is live and per-environment, so no pre-built bundle can be correct). Keep in step with packs/approved.json: an approved client-only pack missing here simply builds on first publish (slower, never wrong); trim this list first if CI spend needs capping.
